openUiAnatomy: no published Open UI spinner anatomy — indeterminate-only loading glyph, union of salt-ds Spinner, shadcn Spinner (wraps lucide Loader2Icon), M3 circular-progress-indicator (baseline, indeterminate). Determinate progress is a separate future component (see docs/SPINNER-MATRIX.md scope note).

behavior.pattern: non-interactive status indicator — no keyboard pattern, no tabindex, no focus/hover/disabled states in any source. The only cross-system behavior axis is HOW loading is announced to assistive tech (role + label + optional repeat-announce), not interaction.
behavior.chassis: skeleton/spinner.tsx — written from the template's part union; inherits from no design system

rows.note: M3 only (latest circular-progress-indicator schema) — a static background ring behind the moving arc. Absent from Salt/shadcn source.
Salt only — two overlapping half-stroked circles, the second wrapped in a fading linear-gradient. shadcn/M3 render a flat single-color arc.
shared invariant, not a gap: no source accepts children/content — Spinner is a closed glyph in all three systems.
no tabindex, no keyboard pattern, no interaction handlers in any source — identical across all three
three different ARIA roles for the same concept: Salt role=img, shadcn role=status, M3 role=progressbar [R] — a real divergence, not a documentation gap
content formatting IS character (same lesson as Calendar): Salt defaults to lowercase 'loading' via an overridable prop; shadcn hardcodes capitalized 'Loading', not exposed as a prop

Salt only — useAriaAnnouncer re-announces the label every announcerInterval (default 5000ms) until announcerTimeout (default 20000ms), then announces a stop notice; announces a completion message on unmount. shadcn/M3 have no equivalent — a declared capability gap, not a silent drop.
Salt: discrete enum small/medium/large. shadcn: not a prop — arbitrary className (size-3/4/6/8), continuous, off here. M3: baseline only in scope (thick variant declared out of scope).
the only visual state — always animating while mounted
shared invariant: confirmed no hover/focus/active/disabled rule in any source — Spinner is non-interactive end to end

diameter shown at size=medium (Salt) / baseline (M3). DECLARED DEFERRAL, same limitation as Button's size prop: per-prop-value style resolution (small/large also render, at different diameters — see spinner.salt.json provenance) needs a generator extension, not yet built.

shadcn: Loader2Icon's stroke is baked into its glyph path, not independently controllable via this component's API — the value here is a REGISTRY RENDERING APPROXIMATION (not a shadcn-sourced number), declared as such rather than left silently blank

derived geometry (radius = (diameter - stroke-width) / 2, minus the track's thickness+gap where a track exists) — each column supplies its own formula/value rather than a shared cross-system token, since it depends on that column's own size + stroke-width + (optionally) track dimensions

Salt only — both gradient stops share one color (the same accent used by the flat arc); the fade itself is the stop-opacity ramp declared as a theme-invariant structural rule in base, since it is always 1→0 by position, never a per-DS value

Salt hardcodes 0.9s inline in source (not routed through Salt's own duration foundation); shadcn uses Tailwind's default animate-spin (1s, unmodified in this repo); M3 [R] — no duration token in the tokens-only clone, registry default applies
